name: Memory (oomd)
author: Arnaldo Delisio (fork of EGOIST's omarchy-memory-usage)
description: Memory usage bar widget that knows about systemd-oomd: kill-line levels, per-app memory by cgroup, and warnings before an app is killed.

barWidget.description: Live RAM usage, PSI pressure, distance to the systemd-oomd kill lines, and per-app memory by cgroup.
